correctness.rationale: A directed Euler circuit exists exactly for a nonzero balanced connected active support; the three off-diagonal balance equations leave a uniquely determined signed triangle flux, yielding F(z). The only disconnected active-support partitions on 3 labels contribute 3S^2, 3PS and S^3, disjointly; their subtraction gives the exact generating function. At z=1 the balanced pole is 1/12 times order 7 and disconnected dominant pole is 3/2 times order 4, yielding n^6/8640 and n^3/4. Other root-of-unity poles establish exact eventual period 6. The standard-library verifier independently enumerates words n<=9 and connected balanced matrices n<=14; no infinite assertion rests solely on experiments.

value.rationale: The labeled ternary circular directed-digram observation space is a natural first nonbinary reconstruction-channel invariant, and all n are classified by a closed rational GF. Beyond an application of Euler tour existence, the theorem determines a previously-uncovered whole-space finite-length count and an exact cubic asymptotic probability that an otherwise balanced profile is impossible, which gives a quantitative zero-error distinguishability bound in the specified channel. Not a routine single-instance computational certificate.
